summary: InterCure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Nasdaq confirmed it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement after its ordinary shares closed at $1.00 or above for ten consecutive business days from August 24 through September 4, 2026. This follows a February 2026 deficiency notice and a September 1, 2026 delisting notice. The delisting matter is now closed and shares remain listed on the Nasdaq Global Market. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special-situation transaction.
